svg.text: Kubernetes architecture — and where EKS draws the line
AWS runs this. You never see the machines.
the only way in. everything talks to this.
the reconciliation loops — one per resource type
WORKER NODES — ordinary EC2 instances in YOUR private subnets. You pay for them, you size them.
kubelet on every node polls the API server, and reports back what is actually running
A Pod is the unit Kubernetes schedules — not a container.
A pod holds one or more containers that share an IP address, a network namespace and storage. Usually one.
Containers in a pod reach each other on localhost, are always scheduled together, and live and die together.
